title: Plain-input 4-CNF SAT with a small satisfying weak 2-CNF backdoor
claims: SmallWeakBackdoor4SATInP constructs a sound language in reference P. It accepts an encoded 4-CNF when a satisfying assignment restricted to a bounded-size set leaves a residual 2-CNF and 8 to the cardinality of that set fits a fixed polynomial clock.
WeakBackdoorStrictExample exhibits a 4-CNF with a one-variable satisfying weak backdoor and no one-variable strong deletion backdoor.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact pinned definitions.
